name: ZeroBounce Official
description:
Validate email addresses instantly with ZeroBounce. This connector lets you verify single emails or
batches directly in Claude, detecting invalid, disposable, and risky addresses to help you reduce
bounce rates, protect your sender reputation, and improve deliverability.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ZeroBounce Official to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ZeroBounce Official to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://oauth-mcp.zerobounce.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ZeroBounce Official MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ZeroBounce Official provides these MCP tools: batch_email_validation and single_email_validation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ZeroBounce Official?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ZeroBounce Official in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does ZeroBounce Official MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ZeroBounce Official requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ZeroBounce Official is developed by ZeroBounce. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
